description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Conditions 3 (Materials); 4 (Ground Levels); 7 (Step Free Access); 8 (M4(2) Compliance); 9 (Water Management); 10 (Landscape Scheme); 12 (Demolition and Construction Management Plan); 13 (Vehicular Visibility Splays); and 14 (EVCPs) of planning permission ref. 76431/APP/2023/3541, dated 24-09-2024 (Erection of an additional storey to existing block of flats, 3 storey side extension and internal alterations to create 1 no. studio, 2 no. 1-bed flats and 1 no. 2-bed flat.)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: Appropriate details in line with the requirements of Condition 3 have not been provided in order to demonstrate that the proposed materials would relate appropriately to the existing building and street scene as a whole in accordance with Policy DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

Appropriate details of step free access in line with the requirements of Condition 7 have not been provided and therefore it has not been demonstrated that housing of an inclusive design is achieved and maintained in accordance with Policies D5 and D7 of the London Plan (2021).

Submission of a Building Control completion certificate confirming compliance with regulations M4 in line with the requirements of Condition 8 have not been provided and therefore it has not been demonstrated that the appropriate quantity and standard of accessible and adaptable housing would be constructed and maintained in accordance with policy D7 of the London Plan.

A dedicated scheme for sustainable water management have not been provided line with the requirements of Condition 9 and therefore it has not been demonstrated that surface water run off is controlled to ensure the development does not increase the risk of flooding and is to be handled as close to its source as possible and Conserve water supplies in compliance with: Hillingdon Local Plan: Part 1- Strategic Policies Policy EM6 Flood Risk Management in (2012), Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 Development Management Policies Policy DMEI 10 Water Management, Efficiency and Quality (2020), as well as relevant SuDs guidance contained within the London Plan (2021) and NPPF (2023).

The submitted landscaping plan fails to provide any detail in respect of the soft landscaping in line with the requirements of Condition 12, including types of species and a planting schedule as well as a design/specification for the refuse storage, means of enclosure, cycle storage or external lighting, all of which are required to ensure that these are appropriate in design and visual terms. It has not therefore been demonstrated that the development will preserve and enhance the visual amenities of the locality and provide adequate facilities in compliance with policies DMHB 11, DMHB 12, DMHB 14, DMEI 1 and DMT 2, DMT 5 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020) and Policy G5 and T6 of the London Plan (2021).

Appropriate measures for construction traffic management have not been provided in line with the requirements of Condition 12 in line with the requirements of London Plan 2021 Policy T4 Assessing and Mitigating Transport Impacts.

No plan showing the vehicular visibility splays in line with the requirements of Condition 13 and therefore it has not been demonstrated that safe access into the site can be achieved in line with Policy T4 Assessing and Mitigating Transport Impacts.

The location of the charging points has not been provided in line with the requirements of Condition 14, therefore it has not been demonstrated that five vehicle charging points would be provided on the site in an appropriate location in line with the requirements of London Plan 2021 Policy T6.1 Residential Parking.
